title: Paperclip-ing approval projection (issue #416)
description: The projected approval object. An approval is a PROJECTION of an existing authority, never a second one (EPIC #410): state is derived from the authoritative record named by authority + decision_ref, and a pending approval (no decision record) can never be promoted by editing the projection. There is no store behind this schema.

kind.description: The approval kind. Each kind names exactly one authoritative surface.

subject.description: What is approved (fleet: issue:<N> for a hire/override, budget:<scope> for a top-up).

state.description: Derived state: pending exactly when no authoritative decision record exists. A pending approval is distinguishable from a granted one by construction.

authority.description: The authoritative surface the decision is read from (governance/dispatch, .fleet/sent, or fleet/control.py).

authority_store.description: The authoritative store the decision records live in (e.g. .board/claims/*.json).

actor.description: The decider recorded on the authoritative record. Empty while pending.

role.description: The decider's role. Must be in the kind's declared decider set, or the decision is refused as unauthorised.

decision.description: The decision read from the authority. Empty while pending.

decision_ref.description: The authoritative record id the state was read from. Empty exactly when pending — a non-empty state with an empty ref is a projection with no record and fails verification.

request_ref.description: The request record that made this approval visible (may be empty when the authority recorded a decision directly).

requested_by.description: Who asked for the approval, from the request record.

reason.description: The requester's reason, carried through from the request record.
